messages:
carla: Quick: new presales ask from Meridian Health. They want a 1-page cheat for SDK streaming + toolcalls + structured JSON output and a tiny pricing hint for ~40 rps at ~1k tokens. Can we do a paste-ready snippet?
josh: Hosted POC only. Short checklist: 1) get ephemeral token via presales endpoint. 2) init SDK with credentialProvider. 3) open stream w/ subprotocol rwd-stream-v1. 4) send meta with schema_id. 5) handle toolcall -> reply tool_response.
evan: Streaming knobs: max_inflight=6, heartbeat=20s, backoff on 429 exponential (start 200ms). For high throughput use short batch REST.
josh: Minimal curl for ephemeral: curl -X POST https://presales.redwood.ai/v1/ephemeral -H "Authorization: Bearer PRESALES_KEY" -d '{"account":"meridian"}' -> {"token":"...","expires_in":900}.
carla: Tiny node snippet please I can paste.
evan: Pasteable snippet:
```js
const c = new RedwoodClient({ credentialProvider: async () => ({ token: await getEphemeral() }) });
const s = await c.stream({ model: 'rwd-4-small' });
s.send({ type: 'meta', schema_id: 'meridian-v1', strict: true });
s.on('toolcall', async (t) => { const r = await callApi(t.args); s.send({ type: 'tool_response', id: t.id, result: r }); });
```
ops-bot: demo-runbook v1 deployed to presales-bucket :white_check_mark:
carla: Perfect. Josh/finance, can you DM a conservative cost ballpark to include? Will share with customer after lunch. :thumbsup:
